get_folders: get all folders for the authenticated user with data integrity verification and access control filtering
create_folder: create a new folder with a given name for the authenticated user under an optional parent folder
update_folder_name: update the name of an existing folder while checking for duplicate names at the same parent level
update_folder_parent_id: change the parent folder of an existing folder to reorganize the folder hierarchy
delete_folder: delete a folder and its subfolders, optionally deleting or moving associated chats
